items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 85:1
items.html: From the aspect of permanence, the hairs of the head and of the beard are discerned as surrounding vessels, for the lights attributed to them — namely the revealed AB — went out of the head of Arich Anpin in the aspect of a returning surrounding light, and their garments, which are the hairs, became surrounding vessels. And at the time of the ascent of Arich Anpin to Atik in a single inclusion, then the stature of the revealed AB comes out again in Arich Anpin, and the returning surrounding light enters the internality of the head, and likewise the hairs again become inner vessels. Then the ten Sefirot of the hairs of the head and the beard are discerned as inner. However, this operates only at the time of the coupling; but after the coupling, the Mochin of Arich Anpin return and are clothed in the MEM-LAMED-TZADIK, and the revealed AB again departs from them in the aspect of a returning surrounding light, and its garments, which are the hairs, again come out of the internality and become surrounding vessels. (Page 390, Item 194).
